# Royalty-free B-roll, music and SFX an AI agent can fetch and legally use

**A missing clip, track or sound becomes a file from a tested source, with its license checked and a credits line recorded.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_ca358f236497.webp" alt="Public-domain B-roll fetched by an agent from the NASA library: the Orion Nebula in infrared, Earth from the space station, green aurora over a treeline and Cassini passing Saturn." width="480"><br><sub>Footage: NASA (public domain)</sub></p>

Find B-roll, stock footage, music, sound effects, motion blocks, lower thirds, transitions, fonts, icons, logos, LUTs and HDRIs that an AI agent can really fetch and legally put in a video. A decision procedure over 97 databases, each tested on 2026-11-03: which ones answer an agent at all, which query works, which license holds, and when to generate instead. Includes 37 tested no-key queries, the traps (easy APIs you cannot use commercially, popular lists that break a license), and a credits file for every asset. Use for "find b-roll", "stock footage for this", "royalty free music", "free sound effects", "whoosh sound", "free video assets", "pexels api", "freesound", "which database should I use", "can I use this clip commercially", or whenever an edit needs a file it does not have. Not for references to study rather than use (find-references) or for the edit itself (edit-footage-with-code).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill video-asset-sources                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills video-asset-sources --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Licensed asset files and a credits file |
| Needs | nothing paid: runs locally |
| Uses | curl, Python, Pexels API, Pixabay API, Freesound API, Wikimedia Commons |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Find 3 free vertical B-roll clips of city traffic at night that I can use in a paid ad"
- "I need a whoosh and a UI click sound, CC0 only, and record the credits"
- "Can I use this Freesound clip commercially? https://freesound.org/people/someone/sounds/123456/"
